scenes.title: Only the Neighbour Next Door
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbour returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: General in an Apron
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, Rocio sits with her ankle on pillows directing Tomas's bread kneading and Clara's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Carrots by the Millimetre
scenes.summary: Javier chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Tomas and Rocio tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Setting Room Nine
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Clara, Carmen, and Mateo lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Put the Speech Away
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, Ernesto nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Clara and Mateo convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: The Heritage Stamp
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks Carmen to play.

scenes.title: Toast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Listening to Carmen's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Rocio, Javier, and Tomas clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: The Tune at the Gate
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Ernesto, Clara, and Carmen learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Ernesto's aunt thirty years ago—and he promises to return Friday at six!
